programme.desc: Soomaa National Park is one of Europes wettest wilderness areas. Floods, forests and wetlands create a landscape where canoes replace roads during the fifth season.

programme.title: Lunenburg: Where the Land Meets the Sea
programme.desc: On the east coast of Canada, a place whose name sounds strangely familiar. The small town of Lunenburg, west of Halifax, was founded in 1753 by North German immigrants. Today, the idyllic town with its many wooden houses is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. In the 19th century, Lunenburg was one of the richest towns in the British Empire, becoming prosperous through fishing and shipbuilding. Glenn Rhodenizer's family traces back ten generations directly to German immigrants. And what the Rhodenizers primarily grow on their fields directly by the sea could hardly be more typical: it is white cabbage, which the farming family processes into sauerkraut. Sauerkraut can be found in every restaurant and supermarket in this area; it is the specialty of the region. The heritage of wooden boat building is successfully maintained by David Westergard. In his ancient shed, he is assembling a 20-meter schooner from four different types of local wood. Building wooden boats, he says, is like "slow food": sustainable, conscious, environmentally friendly, waste-free.

programme.title: Caribbean sisters: The Lesser Antilles St. Kitts & Nevis
programme.desc: In the centre of the Caribbean, volcanoes rise steeply from the sea, thus shaping the sister islands of St. Kitts & Nevis. Their slopes, covered in lush rainforests, snow-white, sandy beaches and the surrounding tur-quoise tinted waters provide the ultimate setting for this record-breaking, albeit tiny island paradise: Both islets are the smallest of the Caribbean dwarf states and also rank among the world’s ten smallest states. A hot pepper sauce, made of a creative mixture of ginger, garlic, thyme and extraordinarily hot chillies that thrive in the hot and humid climate of Nevis, is simmering on the stove of Violet and Llewellyn’s house. Lemmy Pemberton digs up abandoned turtle nests with his bare hands, as he wants to be certain that all of the babies have indeed managed to make it. Members of the Turtle Group catch sea turtles in order to take their measurements and fit them with transmitters. Taxi bus-es are not only the main means of transport on St. Kitts & Nevis, they are also an artistic expression of each driver’s personality. Colourfully embellished, each taxi represents island art on wheels.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The "Parque Natural da Ria Formosa" is one of the largest lagoon conservation areas in Europe. Bordered by five natural islands. A mosaic of sandbanks, brackish and freshwater lagoons and salt marshes. In 2010, the "Ria Formosa" was chosen as one of the seven natural wonders of Portugal. It is a unique ecosystem: in the winter months, more than 20,000 birds gather here. In addition, the nature park has one of the largest seahorse populations internationally. More than half of all fish species in the Atlantic are said to spawn in the lagoon.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The Parque Nacional Peneda-Gerês is the only national park in Portugal. An area of almost 700 square kilometers, located in the extreme north of Portugal. Barren and rocky ridges in the plateaus, contrast with large forests and lush ground vegetation in deep valleys, crossed by lakes and rivers. The park is known for its oak forests, which are predominantly pedunculate and Pyrenean oaks. Among the typical animals of the park are the small Garrano ponies, a very old breed of horse and the only one in Europe that still lives in the wild.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.sub-title: South West Portugal: Alentejano and Costa Vicentina
programme.desc: In the southwest of Portugal lies the little known Parque Natural do Sudoeste Alentejano e Costa Vicentina. It encompasses a narrow coastal strip that runs along the coast to the south of Portugal. Sparsely populated, this coastal region, which was placed under protection in 1988, is considered one of the last intact ecosystems in Europe. The steep cliffs, the almost constant wind and high waves have ensured that mass tourism has not gained a foothold here. There are still near-natural forests and a diverse bird life.

programme.title: The Heart of Hawaii - The Island of Oahu
programme.desc: The Oahu island is the economic and cultural centre of the Hawaiian archipelago, as well as being a paradise for surfers, active holidaymakers and freedom lovers. The island is home to more than half of all natives and almost eight million foreign guests annually. Anyone searching for peace and seclusion won’t find either in Honolulu or Waikiki. Traffic congestion and a backdrop of skyscrapers belong to the town panorama. Hip cafes, galleries and young fashion firms have settled here, adding a new and modern flair to the capital. Cindy’s Lei Shoppe, the Chinatown florists, has been here for more than 30 years. This is also because the so-called Leis, the tradition of floral decoration, usually offered as a flower necklace or as a headdress, is still an important part of Hawaiian culture. Keone Nunes is well-known for his traditional tattooing skills, whereby the so-called Kakau Tattoos are virtually hammered into the skin with a hippo tooth. But Oahu is also an island of overwhelming natural beauty and a fascinating diversity on the smallest of places ...

programme.title: Secrets of the North Sea
programme.desc: The North Sea is enigmatic. It presents itself in cool shades of grey. Yet who would have guessed that beneath the chilly waves are opulent coral gardens, courting squids, and several of the largest sea creatures on the planet?

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: Wild and unknown lies the still undiscovered natural paradise of Bosnia and Herzegovina in the heart of Europe. Rough mountains, dense forests and wild waterfalls characterize the picture of the untouched landscapes. Lynx, wolves and bears roam mountains and valleys. One of the last primeval forests in Europe is a retreat for many endangered animal species. Bosnia and Herzegovina is actually an undiscovered natural paradise in the middle of Europe.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: The barren, karstic south of the country, Herzegovina, also impresses with its natural landscapes. One of them is the Livno field. Not only is it the largest wetland in the country, it is also the largest regularly flooded karst field in the world. About 700 wild horses live in this unique landscape. Their ancestors were working horses that were abandoned here more than 50 years ago. Another special feature of the karst landscape are the rivers with their tufa barriers. The countless waterfalls that pour over it are a unique natural phenomenon.

programme.title: mareTV: Jersey - Sunshine Island in the English Channel
programme.desc: Jersey: the Channel Island is one of the areas in the UK that can boast the most hours of annual sunshine. Not that Dave Cowburn cares very much. He works in the dark, cool ducts of an old bunker from the Sec-ond World War. Here, he breeds turbot, and is very successful at it, too. The "Jersey Royal", the regal potato, has been grown on the island since 1880, fertilized with seaweed from the surrounding ocean. In the third generation, Christine Hellio manages approximately 20 hectares on the coast. "The potato is our most important export commodity", she says. It is harvested by hand, as machines cannot be used on the steep fields. The price is quite regal, too: One kilogram costs 6 Euros. Hugh Gill is one of around 240 voluntary police officers on Jersey. The Honorary Police is regarded as the oldest organised police system in the world. Hugh works for them for one week every month. On the green lanes, the streets of Jersey, the speed limit is 15 miles per hour. Jersey has an immense tidal range and with up to 13 metres difference, it is the world's third largest. This is good for a rarity: the Ormer - one of the world's most expensive species of snail.

programme.title: mareTV: Mexico's Caribbean Coast
programme.desc: The palm tree laden beaches on Mexico's Riviera Maya on the Yucatan peninsula are endless, and the turquoise sea with its gentle Caribbean surf is a warm 25 degrees during the mild winter in this part of the world. Between Cancún and Punta Allen, where once there was little more than bushland and a few sleepy fishing villages, vibrant life has evolved during the past three decades. Richard Sowa has lived on a floating island for the past 15 years: an island he built himself out of empty plastic bottles. The bon vivant him-self sees it as a "solution for our planet's refuse problem". Off Punta Allen, a village in the bay of Sian Ka'an, Mexican Mara Coral Ley and her cousin Kim, continue to catch lobsters by adhering to the traditional method and were awarded an "Eco seal for sustainable fishing" for their trouble. It is silent under water off Isla Mujeres and it is here that the artist Jason deCaires has constructed a sculpture park. Hundreds of lifesize figures form an artificial reef at a depth of 12 metres. Fish and plants complete his work of art. The master himself is convinced: "Mother Nature is the true artist".

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Sichuan Tibet Highway is the road of longing for many. It leads through fascinating landscapes and remote areas up to the Himalayan Mountains. We accompany truck driver Ren Taiping on his trip to the Tibetan capital city of Lhasa, encountering pilgrims, mountain bikers and nomads on this dangerous journey.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The racing cyclists of Burundi have a dangerous job. But it’s a vital one for Burundi’s economy. Bicycles are the main means of transportation in one of the smallest countries in Africa. Bananas, the staple food in Burundi, are transported from the markets to a banana beer brewing factory. We accompany Tharcien, a bike courier, on his exhausting cross country trip on the Burundi Highway.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Canadian ice roads exist only for a few months in the winter when the ice is thick enough. The only time of the year when goods can be transported up to Northern Manitoba. We accompany the truckers Vlad and Hugh as well as the aboriginal Canadian Scott with his pick-up on their long journey to a village called God’s Lake. A risky trip in icy temperatures, sometimes even below - 60 degrees Celcius. The men are in constant danger of getting stuck and need to forget everything they ever learnt about driving on a highway in order to arrive safely.

programme.title: Wild Prairie Man
programme.desc: Located in the Northern Great Plains of Canada, Grasslands National Park has been a 20 year odyssey for wildlife photographer James R. Page. For James, critters are more interesting than people and he shares some of his iconic images and experiences from this endangered ecosystem. We showcase the parks wilderness that is dominated by prairie light and dark sky, the wildlife, prairie dogs, mesmerizing landscapes, and bisons. We immerse ourselves in the wild habitat of Grasslands National Park for over a year capturing some never before scenes in the Wild Prairie. James R. Page's connection to the land and the wildlife provides an unforgettable journey into the heart of this endangered ecosystem, while Park experts help us understand its complexity.

programme.title: Countries People Adventures - Iceland Extreme
programme.desc: In southeastern Iceland, Europe's largest glacier, the gigantic Vatnajökull, covers an area of around 9,000 square kilometers. Beneath it lie the world's most active and dangerous volcanoes. This extreme landscape is as dangerous as it is fascinating: glistening white glacier tongues, lagoons covered with icebergs, bizarre green lava mountains, snow-covered volcanic cones, solidified lava flows and imposing waterfalls overwhelm everyone who gets to see them. In 2008, Icelanders declared the glacier and adjacent areas a national park, the largest in Europe. In this documentary, the team meets people who live, work or do research here: a life with the dangers of fire and ice in the overwhelming landscape of Vatnajökull National Park.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.sub-title: Elephants: Back to the Wild: The Orphanage of Elephants - Nairobi Nationalpark
programme.desc: We follow the rescue of a baby elephant. Once rescued, it will be transported by plane to the breeding station and raised with love and commitment. In order to satisfy the little pachyderm’s urge to move while in the breeding station, there is sometimes an adorable football match between the animals.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.sub-title: Elephants: Back to the Wild: The Return of the Elephants - Tsavo-East-Nationalpark
programme.desc: We accompany the first steps of a two-year-old elephant who is just starting his release program. We also observe the story of two young elephants in their first night in the wilderness on their own. Captivating film footage allows us to truly learn how elephants behave in the wild.

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: glCuba - Brilliantly Caribbean
programme.desc: Even anyone who has not yet been to Cuba can conjure up certain images of American vintage street cruisers, imposing buildings that have seen better days, white sandy beaches full of palms and loving couples on the Malecón against a backdrop of crashing waves. This island is somewhat of a myth and its people generate a special joie de vivre. The legendary Hershey Train departs for Matanzas from the capital, Havana. On the oldest electrified railway line in the Caribbean, 60-year-old Spanish carriages make their way along al-most 100 kilometres of coastline in the most relaxed way possible. The Salvavidas on Varadero, probably the most famous beach on the island, have a particular-ly beautiful workplace. The lifeguards' territory ex-tends for more than 20 kilometres. In order to protect the coasts of Cuba, mangroves have been replanted here for many years. The project is supported by the UN and planting is often carried out by schoolchildren. In doing so, Cuban children learn how to treat their maritime habitat in a sustainable fashion. The former colonial city of Trinidad on Cuba's south coast is gen-erally considered to be one of the most beautiful places in the entire Caribbean. The houses here are particular-ly colourful. A plethora of magnificent buildings can be seen at the Plaza Mayor, the neo-baroque main square.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Some risks on these car routes have natural causes: Extreme weather, avalanches and landslides. In some areas, the locals even believe that evil spirits kill travelers. But many of the dangers are man-made: robbers or terrorists lie in wait for travelers, and tough labor pressures, social hardship and greedy mass-transit businesses also cause tragic driving accidents around the world. In the 20th century alone, 35 million people died on roads worldwide - plus 1.5 billion injured!

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Roads are more than just gray strips of asphalt that allow us to travel and trade. For centuries they have been lifelines of mankind, full of stories and history - and in certain countries and areas they also hold great dangers, much human suffering and death. Documentary filmmaker Oliver G. Becker ventured onto the dangerous roads of Afghanistan's Hindu Kush Mountains, the infamous Moloto Road in South Africa, along the vertiginous slopes of the Bolivian Andes and other "roads of death" in India, Georgia and the Ivory Coast

programme.title: Dream Islands Of Europe: Capri, Ischia and Procida
programme.desc: Capri and Ischia are world famous. From Naples, it's just a short hop over to the two islands. Perfect destinations, then, for a week's cruise along the Gulf of Naples and the adjoining Amalfi Coast to the south. There, Positano, Amalfi or Salerno as well as a handful of other mostly small harbor towns are extremely worthwhile destinations.

programme.title: Discover Poland
programme.desc: The world‘s best helicopter camera system - the Cineflex Camera - was used for this documentary and delivered fantastic images in HD quality, revealing the surprisingly diverse landscapes and fascinating towns of Poland from a bird‘s eye view of Poland‘s medieval towns, the modern silhouette of Warsaw, the untouched nature of the border regions between east and west, the coasts to the north and the mountain ranges of the south

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Olympic National Park is an American national park located in the State of Washington, on the Olympic Peninsula. The park has four regions: the Pacific coastline, alpine areas, the west side temperate rainforest and the forests of the drier east side. Within the park there are three distinct ecosystems which are subalpine forest and wildflower meadow, temperate forest, and the rugged Pacific coast. President Theodore Roosevelt originally designated Mount Olympus National Monument on 2 March 1909. The monument was redesignated as a national park by Congress and President Franklin Roosevelt on June 29, 1938. In 1976, Olympic National Park was designated by UNESCO as an International Biosphere Reserve, and in 1981 as a World Heritage Site. In 1988, Congress designated 95 percent of the park as the Olympic Wilderness.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Olympic National Park is an American national park located in the State of Washington, on the Olympic Peninsula. The park has four regions: the Pacific coastline, alpine areas, the west side temperate rainforest and the forests of the drier east side. Within the park there are three distinct ecosystems which are subalpine forest and wildflower meadow, temperate forest, and the rugged Pacific coast. President Theodore Roosevelt originally designated Mount Olympus National Monument on 2 March 1909. The monument was redesignated as a national park by Congress and President Franklin Roosevelt on June 29, 1938. In 1976, Olympic National Park was designated by UNESCO as an International Biosphere Reserve, and in 1981 as a World Heritage Site. In 1988, Congress designated 95 percent of the park as the Olympic Wilderness.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Saguaro National Park is an American national park in Pima County, southeastern Arizona. The 92,000-acre (37,000 ha) park consists of two separate areas—the Tucson Mountain District (TMD) about 10 miles west of the city of Tucson and the Rincon Mountain District (RMD) about 10 miles east of the city—that preserve Sonoran Desert landscapes, fauna, and flora, including the giant saguaro cactus.An inventory of medium and large mammals in the park confirmed the presence of 30 species in Saguaro National Park between 1999 and 2008. Of these, 21 were found in the Tucson Mountain District and 29 in the Rincon Mountain District. A partial list of the park's mammals includes cougars, coyotes, bobcats, white-tailed deer, mule deer, javelinas, gray foxes, black-tailed jackrabbits, desert cottontails, ring-tailed cats, white-nosed coatis, ground squirrels, and packrats. One endangered mammal, the lesser long-nosed bat, lives part of the year in the park and part of the year in Mexico.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.sub-title: America's National Parks - Gates of the Arctic
programme.desc: Gates of the Arctic National Park and Preserve is an American national park that protects portions of the Brooks Range in northern Alaska. The park is the northernmost national park in the United States, situated entirely north of the Arctic Circle. The park is the second largest in the US, slightly larger in area than Belgium. Gates of the Arctic was initially designated as a national monument on December 1, 1978, before being redesignated as a national park and preserve upon passage of the Alaska National Interest Lands Conservation Act in 1980. A large part of the park has additional protection as the Gates of the Arctic Wilderness that adjoins the Noatak Wilderness. They form the largest contiguous wilderness in the United States together. Fauna include brown bears, black bears, muskoxen, moose, Dall sheep, timber wolves, wolverines, coyotes, lynxes, marmots, porcupines, river otters, red and Arctic fox species, beavers, snowshoe hares, muskrats, bald eagles, golden eagles, peregrine falcons, ospreys, great horned and northern hawk-owls. More than half a million caribou, including the Central Arctic, Western Arctic, Teshekpuk, and Porcupine herds, migrate through the central Brooks Range twice yearly, traveling north in summer, and south in winter. Caribou are important as a food source to native peoples. The park is the northernmost range limit for the Dall sheep. About 132 brown bears reside in the park and preserve, based on a density of about one bear per 100 square miles.

programme.title: mareTV: The white wilderness in Greenland's East
programme.desc: Fjords, glaciers and the highest mountains in the Arctic: East Greenland with its spectacular nature is one of the most sparsely populated regions on earth. The people here live in extreme isolation and depend on helicopter flights for their supplies. Despite harsh conditions, the inhabitants here lovingly maintain their traditions and enjoy their outdoor leisure time even at minus 20 degrees Celsius. The town of Tasiilaq is the "metropolis" with 4,000 inhabitants and offers a very special attraction: the only ski lift on the east coast. Thomas Mikaelsen, the lift attendant, is not to be envied for his job. The only 100 meter long lift comes from Switzerland and is already 20 years old. If Thomas gets the drag lift running at all, it often only lasts for an hour. Then the ski crazy's luck depends on his repair skills. The lift is the only frosty open-air pleasure. For Salo Kunuk his sled dogs are both pleasure and work. He is currently teaching his daughter Karla how to steer a dog sled, private driving lessons from her father, so to speak. Karla will need it, because in the eternal ice the sled is the only means of transportation.

programme.title: mareTV: Denmarks Limfjord - From Sea to Sea
programme.desc: Wide open spaces, water, meadows: The Limfjord stretches through Jutland in Denmark in countless bays, canals and sounds. Mighty water castles, country palaces and magnificent monasteries are enthroned on its shores. It is a rather lonely area, even in high summer it is quiet. This is probably why the people here are so friendly and sociable. Birte, Silla and Bo cycle to their fjord garden project in the harbor of the town of Løgstør to harvest mussels, oysters and seaweed. They think gardening is best in a club. Luckily, Silla, a resourceful tinkerer, has just made another ingenious invention: the mussel washing machine. Cruising the narrow Næssund, a branch of the Limfjord, is the Næssund Ferry, the smallest and oldest car ferry in the area. New on board, and the first and only woman on this ship, is deckhand Lilian Kohler. She is "girl for everything", but wants more, because Lilian is a trained navigator. She is magically drawn to the bridge, but the old captain doesn't think much of retiring ashore.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, The Heart of New England
programme.desc: From New York, the journey up the coast leads into the heart of New England. We visit Yale; spend some time in the 19th century mansions at Newport, RI; tour the coastal fishing and vacation towns of Massachusetts, and then meet a modern entrepreneur in Boston and see her rooftop gardens.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, Florida - The Sunshine State
programme.desc: Nowhere is the American way of life as relaxed as on Florida's beaches. The Keys, a chain of islands at the far southern end of the state, reveal a more laid-back side of the USA. But all of Florida amazes -- with secluded beaches, unspoiled nature, and the legacy of the early European settlers.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, The Southern States
programme.desc: We travel from Georgia through the Carolinas to Virginia, ending near Washington, DC. Along the way we meet a Georgia farmer; talk to painter J. Chris Wilson in Charleston; sail along the Outer Banks of Carolina, and visit rural Virginia, experiencing life in the beautiful southern states.

programme.title: Italy My Love
programme.desc: In ten coastal areas of Italy, we encounter people that have a very special relationship with their region. All of them love their country, their traditions and their work. We met with enthusiasts and hedonists that permitted us to take a glimpse into their everyday lives. Young Italians, who have rediscovered nature and its treasures. Others, that preserve the beauty, archaeologists that apply whole new methods, farmers that only cultivate that which the soil needs. Fishermen, who fish in the same way as it was done a century ago and tough, young men who play and dance the Tarantella. Dolphins, giant sea turtles and pink flamingos, which are researched, nursed back to health or simply observed. Cave explorers, sail makers and coffee specialists are also part of the big picture. Flying drone cameras provide birds-eye views and are an important element of the films. The results are spectacular images from completely different angles which provide us with landscape overviews and detailed insights, the likes of which have never been seen before.

programme.title: mareTV: Wismar Bay - World Heritage and Water Paradise
programme.desc: The Wismar Bay is unique in its diversity on the Mecklenburg Baltic Sea coast: cliffs, sandy beaches, salt marshes, enchanted islands and, last but not least, the proud Hanseatic city of Wismar with its brick Gothic buildings, which are a UNESCO World Heritage Site. When the mighty logs get wedged together in the timber mill in the port of Wismar, Steven Buchholz has to get to work with his chainsaw. It's a dangerous job, because the logs weigh tons. As a trained carpenter, Steven is a virtuoso with the chain saw. Even after his shift is over, he is looking for the thrill: the wind off his home island of Poel is favorable that day and he wants to reclaim the German record in the kite surfing high jump. For a long time, Ramona Stelzer only knew fish as a tasty ingredient between two halves of a bun. But when the goldsmith got her hands on fish leather, her business idea was born: she processes the unique natural product fish skin into fine jewelry. The problem is that hardly anyone in Germany tans fish skin. In order to reliably obtain supplies, Ramona now wants to learn this craft herself.

programme.title: Tren Atlantico
programme.desc: We travel by train from the westernmost point of mainland Europe up to Portugal's only national park, the Peneda-Gerês, and from lively Porto to the Spanish border in the northeast. The train takes you from the blue sea to the green Douro Valley, from the urban metropolis to the scorching heat of the deserted hinterland.

programme.title: Tren Atlantico
programme.desc: Switzerland or Spain? This question is often asked by those who see pictures from northern Spain for the first time: High mountains, lonely villages, but - this is the crucial difference - also breathtaking Atlantic beaches. The "Costa Verde", the green coast, is a piece of Spain that is so different from the general tourist image of the Germans' favorite vacation destination. This area has been spared from mass tourism. We travel by train from Bilbao in the Basque Country to Santander in Cantabria and Asturias.

programme.title: mareTV: The Caribbean for explorers: St. Vincent and the Grenadines
programme.desc: Much more Caribbean than on the islands of St. Vincent and the Grenadines is hardly possible. Deserted beaches, uninhabited islands, lush vegetation, the 33 islands in total are dreamlike with extremely hospitable inhabitants. Miranda Phillips runs a laundry and water boat on Bequia. Every morning, the 32-year-old navigates from yacht to yacht with her small bright green service vehicle and is already expected by most skippers. Miranda promises radiantly fresh laundry, which she delivers again the same day. And so there is always something going on in her tiny laundrette in the harbour. It turns into a karaoke bar in the evening, because that is Miranda's great passion. Eban Olliver has many jobs at once. He is the lighthouse keeper of Kingstown. And that means a lot of responsibility in St. Vincent's biggest port city. Because Eban doesn't just change the light bulbs, he's a pilot dispatcher, harbour master and guard all in one person. First contact with ships is particularly important. Once he even saved the entire nation from an Ebola virus.

programme.title: mareTV: Scotland's Mild West - On The Inner Hebrides
programme.desc: The Inner Hebrides surprise with green hills, fine sandy beaches and a mild climate, at least as far as Scottish conditions allow. This is ensured by the currents of the Gulf Stream, as well as the Scottish archipelago being protected by its sister islands, which belong to the Outer Hebrides. More than half of the almost 80 islands are uninhabited. Loneliness has made the people rather inventive. On Tiree Island, mathematics, history and physics from the mainland arrive in the classroom per mouseclick. Dr Mauvis Gore and Prof. Rupert Ormond cast off from the island of Mull, after setting a course to encounter a basking shark. The cetohinus maximus is the world's second largest fish and the two scientists are absolutely convinced that the waters surrounding the Mull constitute the mating grounds for the basking sharks. A logistical challenge takes place on the Isle of Easdale each September. Then, around 400 people populate the tiny slate island. Donals "Mellon" Melville organises the World Skimming Championships, a World Cup in jumping stones. This is all about the distance they are thrown and they must only hop above the water twice.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.sub-title: The Road To Death In The Andes
programme.desc: The Carretera de la muerte - the road to death- is one of the most dangerous roads in the world. Year after year many people die here. We accompany trucker Omar and his co-driver Jaime on their trip across the Andes, encountering cyclists, mountain bikers and coca-farmers on the way.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Halsema Highway, situated on the island Luzon, leads right through the Philippine jungle with its frequent fog and heavy rainfalls. Every trip on this so-called road is an adventure and highly dangerous. We accompany a bus driver and a taxi driver on their challenging trip across the mountains.

programme.title: mareTV: Estonia's Enchanted Islands - Kihnu, Hiiumaa, Saaremaa & Co
programme.desc: Kihnu is one of 19 inhabited Estonian islands. When the women there ride motorcycles in colourful skirts, it is summer. Thanks to its remoteness, charming traditions have been preserved here. More than 2,000 islands belong to Estonia, none is like the other, each with its own character. Most of them were military restricted areas during the Soviet Union. Of all things, the strict shielding had its good points: beach, forest, juniper groves, they still characterise the landscape of Estonia's enchanted islands. Elly Karjam is a "multi-jobber": lighthouse keeper, ice-cream producer and contract knitter for the famous Kihnu sweaters. Summer is high season for her: She is expecting guests from the USA, who had their ancestors on Kihnu. Birches have to be cut for the so-called viht. This bunch of birch branches is an important accessory for the traditional sauna at midsummer. And the motorcycles in the shed are to be refloated.

programme.title: Wild Skagerrak
programme.desc: The strait that connects the North Sea with the Baltic, with depths of over 700 metres, is notorious for its dangerously strong currents. But currents also mean food and therefore nourishment for the large swarms of fish that inhabit the region. The sea grass meadows are comparable with those off the Californian coast. Harbour seals, grey seals and orcas hunt here, as do the rare black mouth cat shark and porpoises. Close by, catfish mate, which in itself is quite spectacular and never caught on film in this way before. Lion's mane jellyfish with nettle threads of up to 30 metres in length make their way through the open sea. Skagerrak's coastal regions are amongst the most beautiful and varied in Europe and boast one of the world's great bird paradises. Oystercatchers, sandwich and arctic terns are more plentiful here than anywhere else in Europe. The infinitely long dune landscape of the Skagerrak, is Denmark's answer to the skerries of the Swedish and Norwegian coasts. Large seal colonies can be found in the isolation of the small, picturesque islands and one can come face to face with the animals. In this rough, yet infinitely beautiful landscape, the many streams and rivers that open out into the Skagerrak, are quite remarkable. We accompany salmon in an equally beautiful river landscape and meet with ospreys and sea eagles and eventually come face to face with a brown bear mother and her little ones.

programme.title: Wild Bavaria
programme.desc: The moon disappears behind the horizon and the stage is set for a new day in the Alps of Berchtesgaden.

programme.title: Wild Bavaria
programme.sub-title: Wild Bavaria - In The Shadow of the Watzmann.
programme.desc: Mighty and mysterious, King Watzmann sits above Germany's only alpine national park.

programme.title: mareTV: Capri and the Amalfi Coast - Italy's Ocean Legends
programme.desc: Capri was already in ancient times a place for the rich and beautiful. Today Capri is one of the most famous islands in the world. Millions of tourists visit it. But there are in fact still unknown corners on the island in the Gulf of Naples. Thus, at the very top of Capri, there is a hermit monastery with a view to the Vesuvius.

programme.title: mareTV: Martinique
programme.desc: The island of Martinique is a piece of France in the Caribbean, between Florida and South America. And of course, Savoir-vivre applies just as it does on the other side of the Atlantic, between the English Channel and the Mediterranean. Jacky Pascault is the first and only man to cultivate mushrooms in the Caribbean. Everywhere else, they grow on artificially fertilised soil, but Jacky's Champignons Tropicaux flourish on sugar cane fibres. Nicole Vilo tailors hats and dresses out of coconut palms. Of course, the catwalk for the models wearing her first collection is one of the countless dream beaches. The Martiniquais sail on boats they call Yole, which have no keel and are therefore difficult to navigate. The crew members hang over the water in breakneck fashion on long wooden poles. Just the job for Yole-boss Max' "problem kids": they not only learn complicated handling, but also team spirit.

programme.title: Wilderness in Europe: The Bohemian Forest
programme.sub-title: The Psychogramm of a Spiritual Landscape
programme.desc: The Bohemian Forest is the source of the Vltava River, home to primeval forests, untouched high moors and bubbling torrents. This archaic stretch of land, which includes the Bavarian Forest, was long considered impenetrable and mysterious. Since the fall of the Iron Curtain, Bavarian border residents have rediscovered new references to this unusual forest landscape for themselves. This is also the case with photo artist Bastian Kalous, who has been documenting his homeland for years with nostalgic-looking Polaroid photographs and is dealing with its eventful history for an illustrated book. Or Elisa Belotti and Marco Heurich, who have dedicated their lives to the lynxes. In order for Europe's largest wild cat to survive in the Bohemian Forest, the lynx researchers fight for every single animal. Iryna Rudenko came to Zwiesel from Ukraine out of a passion for glass as a material to study at the glass school. After graduation, she would like to stay in Bavaria, Anna Hones grew up in Horská Kvilda, the smallest and highest village in the Czech Republic. The village lies just under 1100 meters above sea level, directly on the former border. The farmer, who experienced communism, the fall of the Iron Curtain and the subsequent changes, is now trying to find ways of surviving in this barren region with her children.

programme.title: Wilderness in Europe: The Bohemian Forest
programme.desc: Pavel Hubeny, whose life would be unthinkable without the forest, is the head of the Šumava National Park. He is committed to ensuring that a primeval forest can grow for future generations, in which man does not interfere. This vision of a primeval forest is also shared by the forester Claus Bässler, who wants to counteract the extinction of species by having trees felled to create artificial deadwood and thus a new habitat for rare beetles and fungi. On the Vltava River lies the small town of Krumlov, the "Pearl of the Bohemian Forest" with its Baroque theater and fully preserved stage technology from the 17th century. Here the director Zuzana Vrbová enchants people from all over the world with her productions. Apart from agriculture, it was mainly the abundance of forests that ensured the livelihood of the inhabitants of the Bohemian Forest - including that of the carpenter Philipp von Manz, who processed local wood for his customers all over Germany. Veterinarian Judith Gollner, who grew up in the Austrian part of the Bohemian Forest, lived in Vienna for a long time and made a conscious decision to return. She likes the people and is proud of "her farmers' wives" who share her love of the Bohemian Forest.

programme.title: Dust And Stripes
programme.desc: In a never-ending quest for grass and water, the striped herds undertake an annual epic trek across the vast lunar landscape of the Kalahari’s Makgadikgadi Pans. Most of the year, the Makgadikgadi is an inhospitable wasteland of windswept, salt-encrusted pans. For the area’s water-dependent zebra, the Boteti River on the western edge of the pans is a dry-season lifeline. However, it is also a death trap, with lions waiting in ambush and crocodiles lurking in dark riverside caves.

programme.title: mareTV: The Eckernförde Bay - Beach shooters, mine clearance divers, squirrels
programme.desc: Fjord, ford, bay, gulf: there are many names for the beautiful extensions of the Baltic Sea into the country. Eckernförde Bay is shaped by currents, surf and people. It stretches 17 kilometers to the town that gives it its name. Stephan Möller is the acting shooting master of the Eckernförder Bürgerschützengilde. He spent a whole year preparing the beach shooting festival and then this: fog, rain and a stiff breeze. Traditionally, the Eckernförde marksmen always shoot at a wooden bird in the direction of the sea at Whitsun. Under strict conditions! And these stipulate a clear view of at least one kilometer out into the bay. The event literally threatens to fall through, for the first time in 449 years. Around 3,000 soldiers are stationed at the Eckernförde naval base, but only a small group is allowed to call itself an elite unit: the mine divers. They are considered the toughest soldiers in the Navy. Anyone who wants to be one of them has to undergo extreme training. This year, just two candidates made it to the final round. Now they still have to pass the dreaded final exam: running 20 kilometers with marching gear and then swimming ten kilometers through Eckernförde Bay.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.sub-title: On the Ohio River with the “Belle of Louisville”
programme.desc: Idlewild - Avalon - Belle of Louisville - these three names stand for the last still roadworthy, historic sternwheeler in the USA. In 1914, the ship was built as "Idlewild" for the West Memphis Packet Company as a passenger ferry. With a draft of only 1.50 m and a robust steel hull, the boat is suitable for almost all navigable rivers of the Mississippi River system. Today, the "Belle" is the most traveled steamboat in American history. In the course of her eventful life, she has called at 130 places in 19 states.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: The paddle steamer "Skibladner" is the oldest passenger paddle steamer in the world in regular service. It has been plying Norway's largest inland lake, the Mjøsa, since 1856. The "white swan" has a melodious name, borrowed from Norse mythology. The ship "Skíðblaðnir" of the god Freyr, built by dwarves, could always have a tail wind, could be stowed in a small bag when folded and all gods in armor had room on it. The traditional ship of AS Oplandandske Dampskibsselskap does not have such fairy-tale powers, but atmospherically the "Skibladner" also transports guests to a world long gone.

programme.title: Broad City: Just the Tips
programme.desc: Ilana innostuu tuhlaamaan tienestejään, ja Abbi paistattelee uuden parisuhteen loistossa. Myöhemmin juhlissa tytöt törmäävät erääseen vanhaan ystäväänsä.

programme.title: Broad City: Mushrooms
programme.desc: Abbi ja Ilana syövät taikasieniä ja päätyvät tapahtumarikkaalle tripille.

programme.title: Broad City: Abbi's Mom
programme.desc: Abbin äiti saapuu kaupunkiin, ja Ilana yrittää selviytyä Sushi Mambeaux'n työkulttuurista kaamosmasennuksen kourissa.

programme.title: Broad City: Witches
programme.desc: Abbi tuntee itsensä vanhaksi löydettyään harmaan hiuksen. Ilana käy seksiterapeutilla.

programme.title: Broad City: Florida
programme.desc: Abbi, Ilana, Eliot ja Bobbi matkustavat Floridaan siivoamaan Esther-mummin asuntoa.

programme.title: Broad City: House Sitting
programme.desc: Abbi, Ilana, Jaime ja Lincoln ovat kotivahtina. Ilana ja Lincoln määrittelevät suhteensa, ja Abbi tapaa erään miehen menneisyydestä.

programme.title: Broad City: Bed Bugs
programme.desc: Uusi, kaunis laukku kohottaa Abbin itsetuntoa työttömyyden keskellä. Ilana ja Jaimé kohtaavat painajaisen, jolta New Yorkissa ei voi välttyä.

programme.title: Broad City: Friendiversary
programme.desc: Tyttöjen ystävyysvuosipäivän juhlinta saa vaarallisen käänteen, kun he todistavat jotain karmaisevaa.

programme.title: Broad City: Stories
programme.desc: Juhlistaakseen Abbin 30-vuotissyntymäpäivää Abbi ja Ilana matkustavat läpi Manhattanin ja törmäävät matkalla sekä vanhoihin että uusiin ystäviin.

programme.title: Broad City: SheWork and S**t Bucket
programme.desc: Ilana yrittää tienata rahaa tällä kertaa perustamalla New Yorkin tupakoitsijoille ulkona sijaitsevan työtilan. Abbi ei hyväksy vuokranantajansa päätöstä kieltäytyä uusimasta asunnon putkistoa.

programme.title: Broad City: Bitcoin & the Missing Girl
programme.desc: Ilana vierailee vanhan heilansa luona ja vaatii tältä omaa Bitcoin-osuuttaan. Abbi vie pyykkinsä ensimmäistä kertaa pesulaan ja menettää suosikkipuseronsa.

programme.title: Broad City: Make the Space
programme.desc: Ilana saa selville hirvittävän salaisuuden Jaimésta. Abbi yrittää nousta vaatteiden viikkaajasta näyteikkunan somistajaksi Anthropologiessa.

programme.title: Broad City: Artsy Fartsy
programme.desc: Abbi saa kutsun hienoon taidetapahtumaan MoMa:an. Vuosipäiväänsä viettävät Ilana ja Lincoln keskustelevat parisuhteestaan.

programme.title: Broad City: Lost and Found
programme.desc: Tytöt tapaavat Ilanan kaukaisen, holokaustista selvinneen serkun ja vievät hänet drag queen -brunssille. Abbi kokeilee uutta tyyliä.

programme.title: Broad City: Shenanigans
programme.desc: Ilana värvätään hiusmalliksi. Abbin uusi ihastus ei pidä Abbia tarpeeksi kypsänä.

programme.title: Broad City: Sleep No More
programme.desc: Abbi ja Ilana vierailevat 'Sleep No More' -teatteriesityksessä, ja Abbi yrittää löytää sopivan hetken kertoakseen Ilanalle elämää mullistavista uutisistaan.

programme.title: Broad City: Along Came Molly
programme.desc: Abbi, Ilana ja Bevers myyvät Abbin New Yorkin -ajan tavaroita. Abbi hankkii liput Lil Waynen konserttiin ja tytöt tekevät pienen 'reissun'.

programme.title: Broad City: Broad City
programme.desc: Hyvästien aika.

programme.title: Broad City: What A Wonderful World
programme.desc: Ilana saa kuulla Lil Waynen salaisesta konsertista, joten hän suostuttelee Abbin lintsaamaan töistä ja etsimään mitä erikoisempia tapoja kerätä rahaa lippuihin. Tytöt eivät anna periksi oudoimmankaan haasteen edessä.

programme.title: Broad City: Stolen Phone
programme.desc: Abbi ja Ilana etsivät Facebookista miehiä huonolla menestyksellä ja päättävät lähteä tapaamaan miehiä IRL, eli oikeassa elämässä.

programme.title: Broad City: Working Girls
programme.desc: Ilana yrittää tienata ylimääräistä hanttihommissa. Abbi lupaa ottaa vastaan Jeremyn paketin, mutta missaa toimitusyrityksen ja päätyy tekemään kaikkensa saadakseen paketin käsiinsä.

programme.title: Broad City: The Lockout
programme.desc: Abbi pakenee tuholaistorjuntaa Ilanan luokse, mutta tytöt päätyvät kadulle Ilanan hukattua kotiavaimensa. Samana iltana onkin sopivasti Abbin ensimmäinen oma taidenäyttely.

programme.title: Broad City: P*$$Y Weed
programme.desc: Tyttöjen on aika kasvaa aikuisiksi. Abbi haluaa ostaa ruohoa ITSE, ja Ilana päättää vihdoin tehdä veroilmoituksen ilman vanhempien apua. Aikuistumispuuhissaan tytöt päätyvät polttelemaan ihan liikaa.

programme.title: Broad City: Fattest Asses
programme.desc: Abbi missaa elämänsä tilaisuuden töissä, ja Ilana tuntee itsensä yritysmaailman hännystelijäksi, joten tytöt päättävät ottaa ohjat omiin käsiinsä kattobileissä.

programme.title: Broad City: Hurricane Wanda
programme.desc: Abbi ja Ilana kokoontuvat kavereineen Abbin luokse hurrikaanin ajaksi. Valitettavasti seuraan liittyvät myös Bevers ja tämän sisko, joiden selvittämättömät kesäleiritraumat uhkaavat tulla Abbin ja Jeremyn orastavan ihastuksen tielle.

programme.title: Broad City: Destination: Wedding
programme.desc: Abbi ja Ilana seuralaisineen yrittävät epätoivoisesti ehtiä kaverinsa häihin, mutta oudot sattumat ja ripustautuvat vanhat kaverit tekevät matkalaisista selvää yksi kerrallaan.

programme.title: Broad City: Apartment Hunters
programme.desc: Abbi on innoissaan myytyään kuvitusta deittisovellukselle ja hän päättää hankkiutua eroon Beversista etsimällä uuden kämpän. Ilana puolestaan joutuu kohtaamaan kammottavan eksän päästäkseen kanavapaketin laskutusikeestä.

programme.title: Broad City: The Last Supper
programme.desc: Tytöt juhlivat Abbin synttäreitä hienossa ravintolassa. Abbi joutuu kasvokkain oman 'ällöttävyytensä' kanssa, ja Ilana kamppailee illallisen sivuvaikutusten kanssa.

programme.title: Broad City: In Heat
programme.desc: Abbi metsästää ilmastointilaitetta jäähdytelläkseen makuuhuoneensa menoa. Ilana puolestaan etsii sopivaa synttärilahjaa Lincolnille, jota ei tunne lainkaan.

programme.title: Broad City: Mochalatta Chills
programme.desc: Abbi saa viimein mahdollisuuden valmentaa asiakasta Soulsticessa, ja Ilana uppoutuu uuteen rooliin riistokapitalistina.

programme.title: Broad City: Wisdom Teeth

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Aasiassa: Phukettimatka Thaimaassa
programme.desc: Uhanalaiset thaimaannorpat Akseli ja Ossi saapuvat pakettimatkalle Phuketiin. Pakettiin kuuluu banaanilettujen lisäksi runsaasti lihaa, kalaa ja kasviksia sekä normaalit ruokajuomat. Kotimainen ruokareality. (42')

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Aasiassa: Monta yötä Bangkokissa
programme.desc: Burgerimiehet Akseli ja Ossi raivaavat tiensä läpi Bangkokin öisten kujien. Kaikki syödään mitä vastaan tulee, mukaan lukien sonninjormakeitto, naudan ikenet ja peräkärryllinen chiliä. Kotimainen ruokareality. (42')

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Aasiassa: Hyvää huomenta Vietnam!
programme.desc: Burgerimiehet Akseli ja Ossi vetävät keittoa Vietnamissa niin innokkaasti että joutuvat Saigonille. Riisinhallinta onnistuu ja perinteinen vietnamilainen munakahvi piristää! Kotimainen ruokareality. (42')

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Aasiassa: Sokka irti Singaporessa
programme.desc: Burgerimiesten Aasian kiertue huipentuu Singaporeen, jossa ajetaan tandemilla päätyyn asti. Matkaoppaana toimii Singapore Sling ja listalta valitaan kaikki kertaa kaikki. Sarja päättyy. Kotimainen ruokareality. (42')

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Pohjois-Amerikassa: Säpinää Seattlessa
programme.desc: Uusi kausi alkaa! Burgerimiehet Akseli Herlevi ja Ossi Lahtinen jyräävät Amerikan halki uusien street food -herkkujen perässä. Eeppinen reissu käynnistyy Tyynen meren rannalta Seattlesta.

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Pohjois-Amerikassa: Pöhinää Portlandissa
programme.desc: Akseli ja Ossi taistelevat villien tonnikalojen kanssa ja iskevät Oregonin street food skeneen kuin miljoona volttia. Mikään ei pysäytä burgerimiehiä, paitsi nälkä ja jano!

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Pohjois-Amerikassa: Kohti Suurta Suolajärveä
programme.desc: Akselin ja Ossin pekoninhuuruinen road trip kohti itää jatkuu uusissa osavaltioissa. Idaho saa pitää perunansa, sillä Utahissa odottavat kaikkien aikojen hodari-överit!

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Pohjois-Amerikassa: Kalliovuorten kuninkaat
programme.desc: Akseli ja Ossi testaavat off road -taitojaan ja tekevät valtiovierailun miljardöörien Aspeniin. Kalliovuorten jälkeen grillataan ja heilutellaan melaa Coloradon koskissa.

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Pohjois-Amerikassa: Hot Rodeja ja biisonipihvejä
programme.desc: Mikään ei hidasta burgerimiehiä, paitsi Hot Rod -festivaalit, Miss Pin up -kisat ja liian pienet hevoset! Horisontissa näkyy jo Texas, mutta sitä ennen käydään biisoniranchilla.

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Pohjois-Amerikassa: Tykypäivät Texasissa
programme.desc: Akseli ja Ossi kutsutaan Dallas Starsin NHL-treeneihin puhumaan oikeasta ravinnosta. Tankkauksen kanssa ei leikitä, sillä Markkasen Laurikin on kaupungissa. Mutta missä on JJ?

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Pohjois-Amerikassa: Rajakaupungin rosvot
programme.desc: Akseli ja Ossi herättävät kauhua golf-kentällä ja syövät enemmän tacoja kuin Texasin laki sallii. Raja tulee lopulta vastaan ja pakoautoa on vaihdettava. Arkansas, hoi! Täältä tullaan!

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Pohjois-Amerikassa: Kovaa virtaa Mississippi!
programme.desc: Amerikan halki iskevät Burgerimiehet käyvät Arkansasissa pitsalla, burgerilla, pastalla ja kylvyssä. Matka jatkuu pää märkänä Memphisiin onkimaan Tennesseen tuoreinta kissakalaa.

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Pohjois-Amerikassa: Sweet home Alabama ja Nashville, Tennessee
programme.sub-title: Sweet home Alabama ja Nashville, Tennessee
programme.desc: Mestarileipurit Akseli ja Ossi vaivaavat Alabamassa. Kun munkit on nähty, siirrytään naapuripitäjän puolelle Nashvilleen Mikael Granlundin ravintoterapeuteiksi.

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Pohjois-Amerikassa: Viimeiset burgerit
programme.desc: Akseli Herlevi ja Ossi Lahtinen lähestyvät Atlantin valtamerta. Matkaa on takana tuhansia maileja ja edessä enää yksi osavaltio, vieraanvaraisuudestaan kuuluisa Georgia. Kausi päättyy.

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Aasiassa: Kaukoidän kutsu
programme.desc: Uusi kausi alkaa! Burgerimiehet Akseli Herlevi ja Ossi Lahtinen singahtavat Aasian kiertueelle uusien street food-herkkujen perässä. Karavaani starttaa Japanin pääkaupungista Tokiosta. Kotimainen ruokareality. (42')

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Aasiassa: Isona Japanissa
programme.desc: Akseli ja Ossi ottavat haltuun Japanin keisarillisen Kioton teeseremonian kautta. Kimonot lepattavat, ramen roihuaa, munakasta menee ja luotijuna laulaa, kun Burgerimiesten Aasian kiertue jatkuu. Kotimainen ruokareality. (42')

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Aasiassa: Samuraiden kosto
programme.desc: Akseli ja Ossi paljastavat miekkansa Japanin Osakassa. Hodariympyrä sulkeutuu ja nyytit käyvät tulikuumina, kun burgerimiehet saavat syntymäpäivävieraan japanilaisen kulttuurin huipulta. Kotimainen ruokareality. (42')

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Aasiassa: Sakeaa menoa Kobessa
programme.desc: Akseli ja Ossi maistelevat sake-panimon tyhjäksi ja syövät Koben härät. Varpusparvi haastaa Ossia, mutta periksi ei anneta. Viimeinen juhla-ateria Japanissa vedetään tappiin asti. Kotimainen ruokareality. (41')

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Aasiassa: Pöytä Koreaksi
programme.desc: Akseli ja Ossi iskevät ginsengin voimalla Korean BBQ:n kimppuun Etelä-Korean Busanissa. Ikonisesta mummotunnelista löydetään mahtavat herkut ja tilaisuudesta otetaan vaari lasillisella sojua. Kotimainen ruokareality. (42')

programme.title: Burgerimiehet Aasiassa: Soulin sankarit
programme.desc: K-pop veteraanit Akseli ja Ossi kutsutaan valtiovierailulle Etelä-Korean pääkaupunkiin Souliin. Ohjelmaan kuuluu kanalan tyhjennys, Aasian hitain munaleipä ja laiton jokiristeily. Kotimainen ruokareality. (42')

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Cherie & Avion

programme.title: Alaska: Viimeinen rintama
programme.desc: Otto ja Charlotte jatkavat kotitilan lantavajan kunnostusta, mutta raskas työ rasittaa Oton tyrää. Sääolosuhteet, vaihtelevat tilanteet ja jatkuva yhdessäolo koettelevat Kilchereitä, mutta kaikesta huolimatta perhe vetää yhtä köyttä ylläpitääkseen omavaraisuustalouttaan. Yhdysvallat 2016

programme.title: Expedition Unknown
programme.desc: Mysteries Of The Great Pyramid. Joshilla on ainutlaatuinen pääsy yhteen maailman seitsemästä ihmeestä: hän purkaa pyramidiin liittyviä salaliittoteorioita ja etsii salakäytäviä. Josh Gates tutkii ratkaisemattomia tarinoita ympäri maailmaa. Hän haastattelee silminnäkijät, selvittää viimeisimmät käänteet ja tutkii sitten itse. 2025

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers World Tour
programme.desc: Serbia: Yugo 55. Mike yrittää vakuuttaa epäilevälle Elvikselle, että kotimaassaan Serbiassa rakastettu 1989-vuosimallin Yugo vetää vertoja VW Golfille. Mike and Elvis are going global! This time, the stakes are higher, the deadlines tighter and the motor transformations are more jaw-dropping than ever. 2026

programme.title: Caught On Police Tapes Sweden
programme.desc: Delayed Ambulance. Ympäristöprotesti viivyttää ambulanssin matkaa aamuruuhkassa. Laiton katukilpailu Värmdössä käynnistää takaa-ajon. Seuraa poliisien rankkaa arkea ja rikosten selvittämistä poliisin omien kameroiden autenttisen kuvamateriaalin avulla. 2024

programme.title: The Ozark Howler
programme.desc: Jess ja Phil kulkevat syvälle Ozarkeille tutkimaan mystistä petoa. Karmivan kuuloisista huudoista saadut uudet tallenteet johtavat järkyttävään löytöön. 2021

programme.title: Kindig Customs
programme.desc: Kevin Hart's Challenger. Kevin Hartin viimeisin hanke on liikkeellä räätälöitävänä. Siihen tulee futuristinen keula ja perä, ja takaikkuna ja lokasuojat saavat hienovaraisia muutoksia. Dave Kindig turns out one-of-a-kind vehicles for his demanding clientele. He works on all types and periods of cars to restore them from the ground up. Yhdysvallat 2022

programme.title: Huutokauppataisto
programme.desc: Greedy Pig. Ostajat suuntaavat taas etelään, nyt Atlantan varakkaaseen Alpharettan kaupunginosaan ja sen paikalliseen huutokauppaan, jossa kaupataan miesten maailmaan liittyvää tavaraa. Sarjassa kierretään maailmalla huutamassa kilpaa noutamatta jääneitä matkalaukkuja, lunastamattomia tilauksia ja alkuperäisten omistajiensa unohtamia löytötavaroita. Mitä sokkona ostetuista laukuista ja paketeista paljastuu? Kuka huutokauppakonkareista onnistuu huutamaan itselleen arvokkaimman sisällön? Yhdysvallat 2014

programme.title: Barnwood Builders
programme.desc: Mark Bowe ja hänen Länsi-Virginian mestarikäsityöläisistä koostuva tiiminsä pelastavat antiikkisia latoja ja mökkejä. Kerätystä puusta luodaan upeita moderneja rakennuksia. Mark Bowe ja hänen ammattitaitoinen käsityöläisporukkansa hyödyntävät uusiokäytössä vanhoja latoja ja mökkejä. He käyttävät puuta ja muita materiaaleja upeiden, nykyaikaisten kotien luomiseen. Yhdysvallat 2019

programme.title: Kullan sukeltajat
programme.desc: Papa Got A Brand New Dredge 2. Kultakuume on käynnissä, mutta arvometalli makaa Beringinmeren pohjassa. Kourallinen sukeltajia on valmiina riskeeraamaan kaiken ja nostamaan kullan merenpohjasta pintaan. There's a gold rush on but this precious metal is found at the bottom of the Bering Sea. A handful of people are willing to risk it all to bring it to the surface. Yhdysvallat 2021

programme.title: Romuaittojen aarteet
programme.desc: Graham S.. Henry ja Fuzz käyvät Southendissä Grahamin varastolla, joka on täynnä pyöriä ja muskeliautoja, itsekoottava Dutton-auto ja muita harvinaisuuksia. Iso-Britannia 2023

programme.title: Romuaittojen aarteet
programme.desc: Will. Henry ja Fuzz käyvät maatilalla Colchesterissä, mistä löytyy vintage-traktoreita. Pojat ottavat mukaansa klassisen Fordsonin ja vanhat liikennevalot. Iso-Britannia 2023

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers
programme.desc: Autokauppias Mike Brewer ja taitava mekaanikko Ant Anstead etsivät kunnostettaviksi klassikkoautoja, jotka he myyvät voitolla eteenpäin liiketilallaan Los Angelesissa. Huonokuntoiset klassikkoautot saavat Mike Brewerin ja Ant Ansteadin osaavissa käsissä uuden elämän. Mikella on ehtymätön vainu löytää romun seasta helmet, minkä jälkeen mekaanikko Ant pistää tuulemaan. Kunnostuksen jälkeen kaksikon tavoitteena on myydä uusiutunut menopeli voitolla eteenpäin. Yhdysvallat 2020

programme.title: Kindig Customs
programme.desc: I Hart Challengers. Dave Kindig rakentaa vaativille asiakkailleen uniikkiautoja. Kaikkien aikakausien autot kelpaavat, ja ne pannaan kokonaan uuteen uskoon. Dave Kindig turns out one-of-a-kind vehicles for his demanding clientele. He works on all types and periods of cars to restore them from the ground up. Yhdysvallat 2022

programme.title: Alaskan erakot
programme.desc: Hard Choices. Pitkä talvi on alkanut ja niin myös ansapyynti. Vanha ystävä tarjoaa Charlielle apua, sillä metsäpalo tuhosi kesällä miehen ansalinjan. Neljä perhettä päättää elää erakkoina, kaukana toisistaan, kovissa arktisissa olosuhteissa ja villieläinten ympäröimänä yhdessä maailman viimeisimmistä suurista erämaista. Yhdysvallat 2018

programme.desc: Blake antaa La Miragen johtajalle potkut tämän piiloteltua tärkeitä paloa koskevia tietoja. Alexis tarjoaa palkkiota tuhopolttajan pidätyksestä ja tuomitsemisesta.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Krystlen huimaukset saavat hänet hakeutumaan lääkäriin. Jackie muistaa nähneensä La Miragen palon alkaneen Claudian huoneesta, mikä todistaa Blaken viattomuuden.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blaken matka Caracasiin Caressiin vapauttamiseksi epäonnistuu. Alexis torjuu Dexin kosinnan. Dex suostuu auttamaan Blakea vapauttamaan Caressin vankilasta.

programme.title: Dynasty

programme.title: Dynasty

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Caress jatkaa Emily Fallmontin kiristämistä. Clay, joka kärsii syyllisyydentunteesta, ehdottaa Sammy Jolle naimisiinmenoa Las Vegasin tyyliin. Michaelin on kerrottava Amandalle totuus.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Kuoleva Emily pyytää Blakea käyttämään kirjoittamaansa kirjettä Alexisin ja Benin petollisuuden lopettamiseen. Clay ja Sammy Jo menevät naimisiin. Nick Kimball yrittää jatkuvasti vikitellä Dominiquea.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blake keksii tavan saada imperiuminsa takaisin Emilyn kirjeen avulla. Sammy Jo saa tietää, että hän ei ole raskaana, mutta ei kerro asiasta Claylle.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Alexis luovuttaa Denver-Carringtonin ja kartanon jälleen Blakelle. Ben yrittää saada Colbycosta yhtä suuren osuuden kuin Alexisilla on. Michael Culhane ja Alexis liittoutuvat Blakea vastaan.

programme.title: Dynasty

programme.title: Dynasty

programme.title: Dynasty

programme.title: Dynasty

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Clay allekirjoittaa vastahakoisesti paperit hänen ja Sammy Jon avioliiton mitätöimiseksi. Blake suostuttelee Leslie Carringtonin pysymään Denverissä ja antamaan Benille toisen mahdollisuuden.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Squire's Riches
programme.desc: Responding to a 2008 garage fire, Illinois emergency response discovered a man crushed beneath a truck.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Home of the Brave
programme.desc: In 2007, the Florida mobile home of Effie and Michael Ratley catches fire. Michael heroically rescues his wife and infant son. A month later, his wife is found beaten to death in a bedroom of his parents' home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Freeze Framed
programme.desc: In 2005, David Castor suffered a slow, agonizing death over a period of days. His wife maintained it was suicide, even though it was done with antifreeze.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Touch of Evil
programme.desc: In the 1990s, the media dubbed Richard Rogers the "Last Call Killer" because he targeted men in gay bars who were obviously intoxicated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Textbook Murder
programme.desc: Avis Banks and her unborn child were brutally murdered. The body was discovered by her fiancé, Keyon Pittman. When police learned that Pittman was having affairs with other women, he became the prime suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Filtered Out
programme.desc: In 2000, teenager Tara Munsey went missing after a work shift at a Virginia restaurant. Did she run away, or was she the victim of foul play?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Water Logged
programme.desc: In 1989, the dead bodies of Joan Rogers and her two teenage daughters were found floating in Tampa Bay.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Social Circle
programme.desc: In 2003, Tiffany Rowell and three of her friends were brutally murdered in affluent Clear Lake, Texas.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Low Maintenance
programme.desc: In 2008, college co-ed Jenna Verhaalen was found dead in her Bryan, Texas apartment. Petechial hemorrhages in her eyes indicated that she was strangled.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fate Date
programme.desc: In 2004, Rebecca Barney and her soon-to-be ex-husband Fred were found shot to death in their Tulsa, Oklahoma, home, which had been set on fire.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Trail of a Killer
programme.desc: In 2003, Kathy Lorick was murdered on a Concord, California jogging trail while talking to her husband on her mobile phone.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Gone Ballistic
programme.desc: In 2008, the body of Colorado real estate developer Alan Helmick was found by his wife, Miriam, who then became the prime suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seeing Red
programme.desc: In 2005, the body of young mother Summer Baldwin was found in a suitcase in a Texas landfill.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Skeleton Key
programme.desc: In 2004, nursing student Tamika Huston went missing from her Spartanburg, South Carolina home. A tip led detectives to her car, where they found an unknown house key that could help solve the case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Funeral Services
programme.desc: In 2002, funeral director Lonnie Turner, Sr. was found shot to death. His son Lonnie Jr. became the prime suspect, particularly after it was discovered that the murder was committed with his gun. However, he had an alibi for the time of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Expert Witness
programme.desc: In 1993, young mother Tammy Tatum was sexually assaulted and murdered in her Longmont, Colorado apartment. Police initially suspected her estranged husband, but did not have enough evidence to charge him and the case went cold.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Disappearance of Helle Crafts
programme.desc: In the series premiere of "Forensic Files", the longest-running true crime series in history, a Connecticut flight attendant goes missing. Police suspect her husband is guilty of murder, but can they prove it?

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Magic Bullet
programme.desc: A fifteen-year-old boy dies from a mysterious gunshot wound to the head while sitting in the lobby of his father's gun club. Ballistics, laser technology, made-to-scale models and the latest in forensic animation are used to find the cause.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The House That Roared
programme.desc: A woman disappears and her husband becomes the prime suspect — especially after police find a huge bloodstain on the carpet of their bedroom. When they spray the bedroom with Luminol, they discover it was awash with blood spatter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Planted Evidence
programme.desc: One morning in a deserted area outside of Phoenix, a motorcyclist discovers the body of a young woman. She had been beaten, bound, strangled and possibly raped. Nearby plants tell investigators more about the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Wilson Murder
programme.desc: On the night of May 22, 1992, Betty Wilson returned home after a meeting and discovered her husband lying in a pool of blood. Jack Wilson had obviously been murdered — but how?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insect Clues
programme.desc: Between 1985 and 1988, 18 people were choked, molested and left for dead in the remote mountains of California. The only witnesses were the insects — and they play an important role in solving the crimes and bringing the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Southside Strangler
programme.desc: Timothy Wilson Spencer was identified as the man who raped and strangled five young women in Virginia. With the use of DNA profiling, an innocent man is freed and the real killer is convicted.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Legionnaires' Disease
programme.desc: After a Philadelphia Convention, 180 Legionnaires contract pneumonia-like symptoms and 29 of them die. The determination of one scientist helps identify the cause of this deadly disease.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The List Murders
programme.desc: In 1971, John List left a note with the bodies of his mother, wife and three children in his mansion ballroom before disappearing completely. Detectives must solve the case, despite having only an outdated photograph of List.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Dirty Deed
programme.desc: In this classic episode of Forensic Files, the longest-running true crime series in television history, Eileen and Derrick Severs disappear from their home in a small village in Great Britain and police find evidence of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Killer Fog
programme.desc: It was the single most deadly automobile accident in American history. Almost a hundred vehicles were involved, twelve people died and more than fifty people were injured. And it happened along a stretch of highway long known for dense, thick fog.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sex, Lies and DNA
programme.desc: While vacationing in California, Earl Morris learns that his wife has gone missing from their Arizona home. The search for Ruby Morris involves dozens of investigators and scientists — and even the Coast Guard.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Charred Remains
programme.desc: Shortly after daybreak, a fire is started in a dumpster in Vancouver. No one sees the arsonist or the fire, which burns for hours in the deserted parking lot. But there's more than garbage in this flaming container.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Postal Mortem
programme.desc: On October 15, 1985, two bomb explosions rocked Salt Lake City and resulted in two deaths. A third explosion occurred the next day; this time, the victim survived.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Micro-Clues
programme.desc: After a day of fishing in a quiet village in Switzerland, a teenage boy doesn't return home as planned. The investigation reveals some important microscopic evidence in the water near where he was last seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Common Thread
programme.desc: After 10 bodies turn up in Florida, one victim — 17-year-old Lisa McVey — is abducted but released. She leads police to the perpertrator, Bobbie Joe Long.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bitter Potion
programme.desc: Flu-like symptoms of a mother and her children prove to be something more serious: thallium poisoning. After the mother's death, investigators turn their attention to finding the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fatal Fungus
programme.desc: An infant is rushed to the emergency room with serious breathing problems. Within months, there are more than 30 similar cases. Can doctors find the cause and a cure?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Delivery
programme.desc: In this classic episode of Forensic Files, the longest-running true crime series in television history, a serial bomber targets a judge, two attorneys and even a courthouse.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Similar Circumstances
programme.desc: Robert Sims returns home after working the night shift and finds his wife unconscious on the kitchen floor. Their son is fast asleep in an upstairs bedroom, but their six-week-old daughter, Heather, is missing.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Crime Seen
programme.desc: Edward Honaker was convicted of rape, sodomy and aggravated sexual battery and sentenced to three life terms in prison. He maintained his innocence. After years in prison and writing countless letters, he finally found someone who believed him.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Speck of Evidence
programme.desc: On September 17, 1984, in a suburb of Tucson, Arizona, eight-year-old Vicki Hoskins left home on her pink bicycle to mail a letter for her mother. She never returned, but her slightly damaged bicycle was found nearby.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Out of the Ashes
programme.desc: On a cold December night in 1993, Rose Larner stopped in a convenience store on her way to her boyfriend's house. She was never seen or heard from again. Rose's disappearance remained a mystery, until a tiny clue is found years later.

programme.title: Frasier: Odd Man Out

programme.title: Frasier: Beware of Greeks

programme.desc: Neal ei kestä isänsä uskottomuutta ja pakenee uuden harrastuksen pariin. Kimin torjuma Daniel kokee muodonmuutoksen tavoitellessaan toista tyttöä.

programme.desc: Lindsay Weir, veljensä Sam ja moninainen ystäväpiiri yrittävät selvitä vuodesta 1980 William McKinleyn lukiossa ja sopeutua joukkoon sellaisina kuin ovat.

programme.title: Freaks and Geeks FI: Beers And Weirs

programme.title: Freaks and Geeks FI: Tricks And Treats
programme.desc: Halloween-illasta tulee yllättävä käännekohta Lindsaylle ja Samille.

programme.title: Freaks and Geeks FI: We've Got Spirit

programme.title: Kirottu kylä
programme.desc: The Final Fall - Part 1. Kun jalkapallovalmentajan uutiset leviävät, Drydenissä toivotaan, että pahin on ohi. Kolme tragediaa vuonna 1996 ristii paikan "Kirottujen kyläksi". Vuosina 1989-1999 rauhallisen Drydenin pikkukylän tiivis yhteisö järkkyi, kun alueella tapahtui useita murhia. Vähitellen alkoi liikkua huhuja, että pittoreski kylä on kirottu. Rikossarjassa mennään ajassa taaksepäin kylmäävään ajanjaksoon ja tarkastellaan tapahtumia muun muassa viranomaisten avulla. Yhdysvallat 2017

programme.title: Houkuteltu tappamaan
programme.desc: Leskeksi jäänyt nainen löytyy raa'asti murhattuna kotoaan Little Rockista. Poliisi saa selville, että tappaja on lähempänä kuin osattiin odottaakaan. Mitä kaikkea epätoivoinen ihminen on valmis tekemään rakkauden vuoksi? Nämä tositapahtumiin perustuvat murhatarinat kertovat synkän totuuden. Kun pariskunta tekee murhan, poliisi selvittää, kuka manipuloi ketä. Miten ja miksi viettelijät manipuloivat jonkun tappamaan puolestaan? Yhdysvallat 2023

programme.title: Kaverille ei jätetä
programme.desc: Kolmen miehen ystävyys on kestänyt läpi elämän. Sen on myös tarkoitus kestää läpi elämän - kunnes he päättävät perustaa asunto-osakeyhtiön.

programme.title: Kaverille ei jätetä
programme.desc: Mainosmaailma on seikkailua, luovuutta, kekseliäisyyttä. Mainosmies on tottunut menemään vaikka läpi harmaan kiven. Siksi mainostoimisto lähteekin elämysseikkailulle.

programme.title: Kaverille ei jätetä
programme.desc: Kesäinen viikonloppu huvilalla antaa suhteeseen uutta potkua. Jukkista (Robert Enckell) odottaa kuitenkin yllätys, joka nostattaa myrskyn miehen tummassa sielussa.

programme.title: Kaverille ei jätetä
programme.desc: Aino ja Saara ovat ystävättäriä - toistaiseksi. Millaista juonittelua ja vehkeilyä on uuden teknologian yritysmaailmassa? Käsikirjoitus Marianne Tikkanen, ohjaus Mikko Mattila. Rooleissa mm. Salli Ahola, Outi Condit, Amira Khalifa ja Merja Larivaara.

programme.title: Kaverille ei jätetä
programme.desc: Metsuriporukka kohtaa futuristisen tiedeyhteisön, joka on muovaamassa totalitaarista yhteiskuntaa. Mutta suomalainen mies on itsepäinen ja kapina kannattaa... Huuliharpussa on voimaa!

programme.title: Kaverille ei jätetä
programme.desc: Mustasukkaisuutta ja rappia. Nuori mies etsii paikkaansa nuoren naisen viereltä, mutta kuinka toimia, kun nainen ei pysy paikallaan?

programme.title: Kaverille ei jätetä
programme.desc: Joulu tulee jopa autokauppaan, missä asiakas ei osaa päättää ostaako yhden vai kaksi autoa. Myyjä taas ei osaa päättää onko asiakas ostaja vai huijari. Kello käy ja kinkku odottaa kotona, mutta asiakas on aina oikeassa...

programme.title: Kaverille ei jätetä
programme.desc: Intohimoisen kalamiehen reissu kääntyy ylösalaisin kuin vene koskessa. Maailma ja avioliitto kaatuvat, mutta se suurin on vielä pyydystämättä.

programme.title: Kaverille ei jätetä
programme.desc: Korona ja politiikka ovat lennonjohtajien intohimojen hämärät kohteet. Läheltä piti -tilanteita sattuu myös ihmissuhteissa ilmassa niitä ei huomaa. Kun oikein pännii, niin lakko auttaa.

programme.title: Handu pumpulla
programme.desc: Veksi ostaa lapsenlapselleen ylioppilaslahjaa ja -lakkia, Stokkalta tietenkin. Vaan mitä neuvoksi, kun onnenkalun hattukoko ei olekaan isoisällä handussa? Onneksi palvelu pelaa myös hätätilanteessa!

programme.title: Handu pumpulla
programme.desc: Fjalle unohtaa vetää kellonsa ja myöhästyy tapaamiselta, mutta onneksi parivaljakko on kuitenkin ajoissa Veksin sukulaistytön ylioppilasjuhlissa, jonne on oikein pynttäydyttykin. Tilanne herkistääkin isoisää poikkeuksellisen paljon.

programme.title: Handu pumpulla
programme.desc: Matka itäkeskukseen metrolla on pojille sen verran eksoottinen yhdistelmä, ettei reissusta taida tulla mitään. Kätevästi juna kuitenkin löytyy Rautatieasemalta, ja perille päästään - tai ainakin päästään jonnekin. Vierailevana tähtenä Mikko Kivinen.

programme.title: Handu pumpulla
programme.desc: Seikkailu "Itäkeskuksessa" jatkuukin niin pitkäksi, että pojat päätyvät yöpymään hotellissa Tammisaaressa. Samalla myös paikallisten villit avioitumisriitit tulevat tutuiksi, ja saadaanhan se takkikin lopulta korjattua.

programme.title: Handu pumpulla
programme.desc: Veksi-isoisä esittelee lapsenlapselleen Korkeasaaren ihmeitä, ja Fjalle-kamu on luonnollisesti menossa mukana. Lajien tunnistus ei vain aina tahdo sujua ihan kaikkien luonnontieteen oppien mukaan. Ja miten niitä sääntöjen rikkojia voi olla Korkeasaaressak

programme.title: Handu pumpulla
programme.desc: Kun Veksin ja Fjallen korviin kantautuu työkeikalla, että tuttua kukkakauppaa uhkaa sulkeminen, on pakko tietenkin piipahtaa paikalla ja kohdata totuus omin silmin. Ja samallahan herrasmiehet luonnollisesti hankkivat daameilleen kukkakimput.

programme.title: Handu pumpulla
programme.desc: Veksi ja Fjalle lähtevät puolisoineen landelle kesää viettämään, vaikka Humallahti tai Oulunkyläkin varmaan jo riittäisi. Ulkohuussi hämmentää ja pelottaa, mutta onneksi tikanheitto ja kalastus ovat tuttua huttua stadilaisillekin.

programme.title: Handu pumpulla
programme.desc: Fjallella ja Britalla tulee 37 vuotta auvoista avioelämää täyteen, ja kyllähän sellaista merkkipäivää kannattaa viettää jo vähän juhlallisemmissa tunnelmissa. Samalla ajan vääjäämätön virta pistää pojat miettimään iän tuomia ongelmia.

programme.title: Handu pumpulla
programme.desc: Fjallen sairaalareissu saa Veksin muistelemaan menneitä tavallistakin ponnekkaammin. Muisteloissa käydään läpi muun muassa Veksin hääpäivä, josta ei dramatiikkaa puuttunut. Nykypäivässä huoli ja murhe parhaasta kaverista on kova.

programme.title: Handu pumpulla
programme.desc: Korkeasaaren lautan tarpeettoman heiluva käynti ärsyttää poikia niin, että asiasta päätetään kirjelmöidä ihan kaupungin pormestarille asti. Ja kun Fjalle ja Veksi ovat asialla, pormestarihan täytyy luonnollisesti päästä tapaamaan ihan henkilökohtaisesti.

programme.title: Handu pumpulla
programme.desc: Joulu lähestyy jo uhkaavasti Stadiakin, mutta onneksi Fjalle lupaa hankkia sellaisen kuusen, että porukalta lähtee jalat alta. Kuusikaupoilla pitääkin olla varuillaan, ettei joudu huijatuksi.

programme.title: Handu pumpulla
programme.desc: Stadilaisen jouluun kuuluu tietenkin rentouttava saunominen Harjutorin saunassa, mutta Veksiä jännittää silti kovasti illalla odottava joulupukkikeikka. Onneksi vanhalla nyrkkeilijällä on paras mahdollinen tsemppaaja ja ystävä, nimittäin Fjalle.
